events.title: Shopify launched
events.summary: Tobi Lütke launched Shopify on June 2, 2006 — moving the Snowdevil snowboard store platform out of beta as a hosted e-commerce product.
events.about: Shopify lets merchants sell online without building checkout, inventory, and payments from scratch — themes, apps, and Liquid templates on a hosted Rails stack. It grew from a snowboard shop side project into the default SMB e-commerce platform, powering DTC brands and competing with Magento.

narrative.whyChosen: Shopify made launching an online store as easy as signing up for [SaaS] instead of hiring an agency.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved Ruby on Rails could scale hosted commerce and inspired the app-store model for merchant extensions.
narrative.problemSolved: Small retailers hated brittle custom stores and expensive enterprise e-commerce suites.
